title: Map setup tools on the left
summary: Dungeon Masters now place the party, markers, entrances, records and location links from a setup rail on the left of the map, each with its own small panel.
items: Choose a setup tool, click the map, and its panel opens right beside it, instead of inside the long Settings drawer.
After saving, the tool stays ready, so you can drop several markers in a row. Esc closes the panel; Esc again returns to panning.
Entrances can pick their arrival view on the destination map: pan and zoom there, then choose Use this view.
On phones the setup tools sit in a second bar under the title, and search becomes a magnifier icon. Players' phone layout is unchanged.
Every form is still in Settings as before.
